nodes.description: Private mapping of address to token balance in ERC20.
Private nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance.
Private total token supply counter.
Private token name string set in constructor.
Private token symbol string set in constructor.
Constant generator URL string.
Private generator version string set in constructor.
Internal view returning msg.sender, the caller context used across the token.
Internal view returning msg.data calldata.
Public view returning the stored token name.
Public view returning the stored token symbol.
Public view returning hardcoded 18 decimals.
Public view returning _totalSupply.
Public view returning balance for a given account.
Public token transfer moving funds from the caller via internal _transfer.
Public view returning owner-spender allowance.
Public approval setting spender allowance via _approve.
Public transferFrom enforcing allowance then decreasing it.
Public allowance increase using unchecked-style addition expression.
Public allowance decrease with require guard and subtraction.
Internal transfer moving balances, invoking the _beforeTokenTransfer hook and arithmetic on balances.
Internal mint increasing total supply and recipient balance, invoking transfer hook.
Internal burn decreasing account balance and total supply, invoking transfer hook.
Internal allowance writer storing spender allowance in _allowances.
Overridable transfer hook called before every mint, burn and transfer.
Constructor initializing token name and symbol state variables.
Payable constructor forwarding msg.value to the fee receiver via external call.
Constructor storing the generator version string.
Public pure returning the constant generator URL.
Public view returning the generator version string.
Payable constructor wiring ERC20/ServicePayer/GeneratorCopyright and minting 10000e18 to the caller.
Untrusted caller identity used for minting and allowance ownership.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) to an attacker-influenceable receiver.
Balance arithmetic senderBalance - amount and _balances[recipient] += amount.
Supply arithmetic _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount.
Supply arithmetic accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount.
Allowance arithmetic currentAllowance - amount after require guard.
Allowance arithmetic _allowances[..][..] + addedValue.
Allowance arithmetic currentAllowance - subtractedValue after require guard.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside _msgSender, propagating untrusted caller identity through the whole contract.
HelloERC20 constructor mints the whole initial supply to the untrusted caller identity.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the source of the token movement.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom reads the caller allowance via _msgSender().
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the owner of the allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the owner of the allowance.
_transfer receives the caller from _msgSender() as the sender argument.
HelloERC20 constructor uses _msgSender() as mint recipient.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
approve invokes the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes _approve to reduce the remaining allowance.
increaseAllowance invokes _approve with the summed allowance.
decreaseAllowance invokes _approve with the reduced allowance.
_transfer calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated, an external-callback style reentrancy vector.
_mint calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before supply and balance updates.
_burn calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balance and supply updates.
HelloERC20 constructor mints the fixed initial supply through _mint.
HelloERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer constructor with the fee receiver.
ServicePayer constructor performs the external payable pay call to the receiver.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_mint increases the recipient entry in _balances.
_mint increases the _totalSupply counter.
_burn decreases the account entry in _balances.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply counter.
_approve writes the owner-spender entry in _allowances.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
name returns the _name state variable.
symbol returns the _symbol state variable.
generator returns the constant _GENERATOR state variable.
version returns the _version state variable.
GeneratorCopyright constructor writes _version.
ERC20 constructor writes the _name state variable.
ERC20 constructor writes the _symbol state variable.
_transfer performs balance subtraction and addition that constitute arithmetic operations.
_mint performs supply and balance additions that constitute arithmetic operations.
_burn performs balance and supply subtractions that constitute arithmetic operations.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount as an arithmetic operation.
increaseAllowance computes allowance + addedValue as an arithmetic operation.
decreaseAllowance computes currentAllowance - subtractedValue as an arithmetic operation.
account parameter is used to index _balances in balanceOf.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
sender parameter is the debit source in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is the credit target in transferFrom.
amount parameter drives the allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
spender parameter is the approval target in approve.
amount parameter flows into approve.
owner parameter indexes _allowances in allowance.
spender parameter indexes _allowances in allowance.
name_ parameter initializes _name in the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter initializes _symbol in the ERC20 constructor.
name_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ parameter is forwarded to the ServicePayer constructor.
receiver parameter is the target of the external pay call.
serviceName parameter is forwarded into the external pay call.
version_ parameter initializes _version.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the current allowance.
from parameter flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to parameter flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
amount parameter flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
transferFrom declares and populates the currentAllowance local variable.
currentAllowance local is used in the transferFrom subtraction arithmetic.
_transfer declares and populates the senderBalance local variable.
senderBalance local is used in the _transfer balance subtraction.
_burn declares and populates the accountBalance local variable.
accountBalance local is used in the _burn balance subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter account only exists to index _balances inside balanceOf and can be absorbed into that core function node.
Parameter recipient is a transient argument of transfer and is merged into the transfer function node.
Parameter amount is a transient argument of transfer and is merged into the transfer function node.
Parameter spender is a transient argument of approve and is merged into the approve function node.
Parameter sender is a transient argument of transferFrom and is merged into the transferFrom function node.
Parameter owner is a transient argument of allowance and is merged into the allowance function node.
Parameter name_ is only consumed by the ERC20 constructor to set _name.
Parameter symbol_ is only consumed by the ERC20 constructor to set _symbol.
Parameter receiver is the target of the external pay call issued by the ServicePayer constructor.
Parameter serviceName is forwarded into the external pay call from the ServicePayer constructor.
Parameter version_ only exists to initialize _version in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Parameter addedValue only feeds the allowance addition in increaseAllowance.
Parameter subtractedValue only feeds the allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
Parameter feeReceiver_ is only forwarded to the ServicePayer constructor by the HelloERC20 constructor.
Parameter from is a hook argument flowing only into _beforeTokenTransfer.
Parameter to is a hook argument flowing only into _beforeTokenTransfer.
Local currentAllowance is a temporary cache inside transferFrom and is absorbed into that function node.
Local senderBalance is a temporary cache inside _transfer and is absorbed into that function node.
Local accountBalance is a temporary cache inside _burn and is absorbed into that function node.
